footer_content_label: Hindawi Foundation is a registered charity no. 1181788 in England and Wales. Registered address: York House, 41 Sheet Street, Windsor, SL4 1DD.
reading_changes_everything_content_label: We promote the joy of reading by making books free and accessible. We aspire to reach readers across the world in every language.
what_we_do_content_label: Our goal is to instill a lifelong passion for reading in people of all ages worldwide. We provide free access to a world of literature, ensuring that the transformative power of a good book is always within reach.
booktime_content_label: Highly illustrated children’s books in multiple languages for free.
safahat_content_label: A diverse library empowering readers with access to free literature in Arabic.
folios_content_label: An advanced AI translation tool that breaks down language barriers to global literature.
help_us_spread_the_joy_of_reading_label: Help us spread the joy of reading
why_we_do_it_first_content_label: children globally lack access to age-appropriate reading materials (UNESCO, 2023).
why_we_do_it_second_content_label: of books are published in only a handful of dominant languages (UNESCO, 2012).
why_we_do_it_third_content_label: Over 20% reduction in mortality and depression rates in adults who read books (NLT, 2024 & Bavishi, Slade & Levy, 2016).
why_we_do_it_fourth_content_label: of children in middle- to low-income countries do not have a children’s book at home (UNICEF, 2021).
help_us_spread_the_joy_of_reading_title_: Help Us Spread the Joy of Reading!
help_us_spread_the_joy_of_reading_conten: Every great story needs a champion. Your support allows us to write and illustrate more books for Booktime, license new material for Safahat, and improve Folios.
partners_content_label: A special thanks to our partners!
donation_intro_content_label: Everyone deserves to have access to literature and to experience the joy of reading. Your support directly fuels our global mission, allowing us to publish more books, expand into new languages, and improve our technology. Whether you give once or monthly, your generosity helps us break down language barriers and reach more readers worldwide.
donation_contact_label: If you would like to speak to us about directing your donation toward a specific book, language, or project, please contact us at {donation_email}.
testimonials_first_quote_label: “The quality of the refined translation using Gemini Pro was staggering. It captured the nuances of my protagonist’s dialect better than any tool I’ve used before. It’s truly a game changer for literary work.”
testimonials_second_quote_label: “Being able to translate my entire back catalog into three different languages in one afternoon for a fraction of traditional costs is a game changer.”
